requiredCriteria.criterion: dwp-platform-server is the only automation control-plane runtime and no dwp-sys-server is introduced.
The exact primary API, PEP and event ownership is implemented while IAQ-059, SYS-API-035/036/038 and SYS-EVT-009 remain SYS-002 reuse-only with zero recount.
SYS-API-017 POST creates definition identity and metadata only; version, schedule and activation concerns are rejected and delegated to their normalized APIs.
PDX-004, PDX-005 and PDX-006 are reused with the sealed identity, schema-version, retry-mode, state and field mappings.
V333 creates exactly eight sys_automation tables, reuses the shared receipt/outbox/inbox/audit facilities and enforces tenant-composite RLS boundaries.
Only signed compatible allowlisted typed handlers execute; arbitrary class, method or SQL dispatch is impossible.

Definition versions persist and revalidate exact signature, schema, policy, compatibility, validation and approval evidence, enforce maker-checker and CAS, allocate multiple independently target-bound pre-active candidates but only one ACTIVE version, and require a currently ACTIVE registry manifest at every sealed dispatch boundary.

Schedules pin one approved version, timezone, expression, input template digest and concurrency-key template, cannot fire before activation, separate policy/object revisions from cursor-only fire revision, preserve approval evidence across cursor advancement and deduplicate each deterministic UTC fire with safe decimal-string JCS identity plus the sealed DST and SKIP_MISSED policy.

Runs enforce caller/action-bound idempotency with target and handler in the request digest, server-resolved concurrency exclusion, mutually exclusive WORKER/OWNER_RECOVERY/RECONCILER fences, branch-complete worker, no-active-lease and reconciler recovery and immutable terminal facts.

Retry creates new immutable attempts according to NONE, FAILED_ITEMS_ONLY or WHOLE_INVOCATION, freezes the exact selection, never repeats successful effects and resumes strictly after a monotonic fenced checkpoint.

Cancellation after an original effect requires a separately fenced RECONCILER to execute only the approved idempotent compensation path with a distinct key and PREPARED to COMMITTED or RESULT_UNKNOWN receipt; after dispatch-fence loss a newly fenced RECONCILER may finalize that PREPARED only from matching trusted evidence without redispatch, shared command receipts enforce closed transitions and terminal guards, and RESULT_UNKNOWN remains separately reconciled without blind redispatch.

SYS-EVT-004 uses the closed minimal payload and DEP-003 envelope with exact revision ordering, safe-number or canonical decimal-string integer encoding, counts, RFC-8785/JCS receipt-set digest, atomic one-event-per-run-revision outbox publication, immutable terminal events and no raw or personal payload.

The existing settings operations route composes a separately authorized child surface, exposes only the intersection of lifecycle-state allowlist, current persisted eligibility, caller command authorization and visible target facts, and creates no second sidebar or page owner.
The frontend covers accessible responsive loading, empty, complete, partial, unavailable, forbidden, retry and step-up states at 1440, 1280, 390 and 320 widths and 200 percent zoom.

HRIS_AUTOMATION_CONTROL_PLANE remains default OFF with zero enrolled tenants, no mounted child surface, no production schedules or providers and zero business-completion credit until later activation authority.
